content: PRF browser support mid-2026: Chrome 147 supports PRF-on-create on Windows (146- did not); macOS 15 + Chrome 132+ via iCloud Keychain works; Firefox 148+ supports PRF with Windows Hello on both create and get (147 backported create-time); Safari 18+ works via iCloud Keychain but Safari on iOS/iPadOS cannot pass extension data to/from external roaming authenticators (YubiKey hmac-secret unusable in Safari mobile); Windows Hello only returns PRF values after Feb 2026 update (KB5077181, WEBAUTHN_API_VERSION_8) - earlier 25H2 builds lack it; Android has broad support across browsers/authenticators but some Android 14 credential providers don't implement hmac_secret.
